- SKU mapping: please send a single-sheet CSV mapping your "Cerulean SKU" column to our internal billing SKU. That will avoid line-item mismatches on the ledger.

I've attached a short procurement_checklist.xlsx that lists the fields we need for the vendor profile. Once we receive completed checklist + W-9, Procurement will escalate to Finance for final PO issuance and spend cap approval.

If Cerulean can accept TEMP-PO-8742 immediately, we can kick off provisioning and allow initial charges up to $25k. To increase the provisional cap to $50k requires a fast-track review (SOC2 summary + W-9) which we can request — Marissa, can you confirm the fast-track threshold and whether Finance is comfortable with $50k provisional on receipt of W-9 + SOC2 doc?

Thanks,
